title: Bakewell Travel
transcript:
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Hello, Bakewell Travel. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Oh, hello. My name’s Sarah Carter. I wonder if you could tell me about the price of plane tickets to Dubai.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Our computers are down, so what I can do is take some details about you and your travel plans. Then, when everything’s OK again, I can call you back. All right?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: OK, then.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: So, some details first. Your name was Sarah Carter, wasn’t it?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: That’s right.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: And can I take a contact phone number?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: 07 958 847 222.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Now, I’ll probably need to get back to you on this. Shall I call you back tomorrow morning?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Oh, I work on Wednesdays. Can you call me back on Thursday before 12?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Fine. OK, so, Mrs Carter, how many tickets will you need?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Three adults and four children.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: So, seven altogether. Are all the children under the age of 14?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: They are, yes.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Which date do you wish to travel on?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Well, we definitely need to be there for the 24th. So, if we leave the UK on the 22nd, we’ll have time to recover on the 23rd.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: So, the 22nd of October?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Not this month. Next month, November.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Right. And I assume these are return tickets?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Yes, we want to fly back on the Tuesday. Is that the 25th or the 26th?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: It’s the 25th. So, it’s going to be a short holiday.
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: We’re going to a wedding. We’re not going for a holiday.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Oh, that’s nice. Now, do any travellers have any special requirements? You know, special assistance with mobility and that sort of thing?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Oh, well, actually, yes. My son’s allergic to cheese. It makes him really, really ill.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Fine. So, as soon as I can, I’ll look into finding some tickets for you. Travel Agent: Now, I wonder if I could just ask you a couple of questions as part of our market research. Would you be happy to do that?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Will this take long?
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Just a couple of minutes. That’s all.
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: OK.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: So, how many foreign visits have you made in the last 12 months?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: About six, I suppose.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: And where was your last foreign trip?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Well, I was in Egypt in May.
And most recently, India.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Oh, nice. Yes, I’m off for some IT training in Bangalore next month, actually. And was that a vacation?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: I’d love to go back there for a holiday, but it was for business this time.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: And I presume you use the Internet?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: I do, yes.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: And so you’ve seen our website?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Yes, I had a look this morning, actually.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Well, we had it redesigned a month ago and we’re keen to get feedback on how our customers find it. So...
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Oh, right. OK. Well, I have to say I found it terribly slow, so I just gave up and thought I’d give you a call.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Well, I’m sorry to hear that. But yes, it does happen sometimes. Would it be OK for us to email you with any promotional offers?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: I suppose so. Well, OK. My address is carter.s at speedtech.com.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: Is that S-P-E-E-D-T-E-C-H?
Speaker 2: Sarah Carter: Yes.
Speaker 1: Travel Agent: That’s great. And can I ask how you found out about Bakewell Travel?
